verses.geez: ኀበ፡ ተናገረ፡ ኤልዩ፡ አውሥአ፡ ወይቤ።
verses.translation: And Elius further continued, and said,

translations.lxx: And Elius further continued, and said,
translations.kjv: Elihu also proceeded, and said,
translations.ron: Elihu a mers mai departe şi a grăit:
translations.grk: Προσθεὶς δὲ ἔτι Ἐλιοὺς, λέγει,

verses.geez: ተዓገሠኒ፡ ዓዲ፡ ኅዳጠ፡ ወእሜህረከ፡ ዓዲ፡ ብየ፡ ነገር፡ ኀቤየ።
verses.translation: Wait for me yet a little while, that I may teach thee: for there is yet speech in me.

translations.lxx: Wait for me yet a little while, that I may teach thee: for there is yet speech in me.
translations.kjv: Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God’s behalf.
translations.ron: "Aşteaptă o clipă şi vei învăţa şi altele, căci sunt încă temeiuri şi cuvinte de partea lui Dumnezeu.
translations.grk: Μεῖνόν με μικρὸν ἔτι, ἵνα διδάξω σε· ἔτι γὰρ ἐν ἐμοί ἐστι λέξις.

verses.geez: እትሜጠዋ፡ ለነገርየ፡ እምኁቅ፡ ምግባርየሰ፡ ጻድቅ፡ እበል።
verses.translation: Having fetched my knowledge from afar, and according to my works,

translations.lxx: Having fetched my knowledge from afar, and according to my works,
translations.kjv: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
translations.ron: Voi porni cu ştiinţa mea de departe şi voi dovedi dreptatea Ziditorului meu.
translations.grk: Ἀναλαβὼν τὴν ἐπιστήμην μου μακράν, ἔργοις δέ μου δίκαια ἐρῶ ἐπʼ ἀληθείας,

verses.geez: እሙን፡ ነገርየ፡ ዘኢኮነ፡ ሐሰተ፡ ወዓመፃ፡ ኢይሰምዕ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: I will speak just things truly, and thou shalt not unjustly receive unjust words.

translations.lxx: I will speak just things truly, and thou shalt not unjustly receive unjust words.
translations.kjv: For truly my words shall not be false: he that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.
translations.ron: Căci cu adevărat ceea ce-ţi spun eu nu este minciună şi cal ce stă lângă tine este unul desăvârşit în cunoştinţă.
translations.grk: καὶ οὐκ ἄδικα ῥήματα ἀδίκως συνιεῖς.

verses.geez: አእምር፡ ባሕቱ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይገድፎ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለየዋህ፡ ኃያል፡ ወጽኑዕ፡ ውእቱ።
verses.translation: But know that the Lord will not cast off an innocent man: being mighty in strength of wisdom,

translations.lxx: But know that the Lord will not cast off an innocent man: being mighty in strength of wisdom,
translations.kjv: Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: he is mighty in strength and wisdom.
translations.ron: Fireşte, Dumnezeu este prea puternic, dar nu leapădă pe nimeni; El este prea puternic prin înălţimea înţelepciunii Sale.
translations.grk: Γίνωσκε δὲ, ὅτι ὁ Κύριος οὐ μὴ ἀποποιήσηται τὸν ἄκακον, δυνατὸς ἰσχύϊ καρδίας

verses.geez: ወኢያሐይዎ፡ ለልበ፡ ኃጥእ፡ ወይሁብ፡ ፍትሐ፡ ለነዳያን።
verses.translation: he will not by any means save alive the ungodly: and he will grant the judgment of the poor.

translations.lxx: he will not by any means save alive the ungodly: and he will grant the judgment of the poor.
translations.kjv: He preserveth not the life of the wicked: but giveth right to the poor.
translations.ron: El nu lasă pe nelegiuit să propăşească şi celor nenorociţi le face dreptate.
translations.grk: ἀσεβῆ οὐ μὴ ζωοποιήσῃ, καὶ κρίμα πτωχῶν δώσει.

verses.geez: ወኢያአትት፡ አዕይንቲሁ፡ እምጻድቅ፡ ወየሐትቶ፡ ለጻድቅወይነብሮ፡ ውስተ፡ መናብርት፡ ምስለ፡ ነገሥት፡ ወያነብሮሙ፡ በዕልገቶሙ፡ መልዕልተ፡ ወይከብሩ።
verses.translation: He will not turn away his eyes from the righteous, but they shall be with kings on the throne: and he will establish them in triumph, and they shall be exalted.

translations.lxx: He will not turn away his eyes from the righteous, but they shall be with kings on the throne: and he will establish them in triumph, and they shall be exalted.
translations.kjv: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings are they on the throne; yea, he doth establish them for ever, and they are exalted.
translations.ron: El nu despoaie pe cei drepţi de dreptatea lor, iar cu împăraţii la fel: îi pune în jeţuri împărăteşti şi-i aşază să domnească de-a pururi. Dar ei se umflă de trufie.
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἀφελεῖ ἀπὸ δικαίου ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ, καὶ μετὰ βασιλέων εἰς θρόνον, καὶ καθιεῖ αὐτοὺς εἰς νῖκος, καὶ ὑψωθήσονται.

verses.geez: ወእለሂ፡ ሙቁሐን፡ እደዊሆሙ፡ በሰናስል፡ ይትአኀዙ፡ በሐብለ፡ ንዴት።
verses.translation: But they that are bound in fetters shall be holden in cords of poverty.

translations.lxx: But they that are bound in fetters shall be holden in cords of poverty.
translations.kjv: And if they be bound in fetters, and be holden in cords of affliction;
translations.ron: Şi atunci iată-i ferecaţi cu lanţuri şi iată-i prinşi cu funiile mâhnirii.
translations.grk: Καὶ οἱ πεπεδημένοι ἐν χειροπέδαις, συσχεθήσονται ἐν σχοινίοις πενίας.

verses.geez: ወይነግሮሙ፡ ምግባሮሙ፡ ወጌጋዮሙሂ፡ እስመ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ውእቱ።
verses.translation: And he shall recount to them their works, and their transgressions, for such will act with violence.

translations.lxx: And he shall recount to them their works, and their transgressions, for such will act with violence.
translations.kjv: Then he sheweth them their work, and their transgressions that they have exceeded.
translations.ron: După aceea, Dumnezeu le dezvăluie fapta pe care au făcut-o şi nelegiuirea în care au căzut, anume că s-au trufit.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀναγγελεῖ αὐτοῖς τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν, καὶ τὰ παραπτώματα αὐτῶν, ὅτι ἰσχύσουσιν.

verses.geez: ወዳእሙ፡ ለጻድቃን፡ ይሰምዖሙ፡ ወይቤ፡ ይትመየጡ፡ እምኃጢአቶሙ።
verses.translation: But he will hearken to the righteous: and he has said that they shall turn from unrighteousness.

translations.lxx: But he will hearken to the righteous: and he has said that they shall turn from unrighteousness.
translations.kjv: He openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity.
translations.ron: Dar El le face această destăinuire ca să ia aminte şi le dă poruncă să se întoarcă de la răutatea lor;
translations.grk: Ἀλλὰ τοῦ δικαίου εἰσακούσεται· καὶ εἶπεν ὅτι ἐπιστραφήσονται ἐξ ἀδικίας.

verses.geez: ለእመ፡ ሰምዑ፡ ወይትቀመዩ፡ ወይፌጽሙ፡ መዋዕሊሆሙ፡ በሠናይ፡ ወዓመታቲሆሙ፡ በተድላ።
verses.translation: If they should hear and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in honour.

translations.lxx: If they should hear and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in honour.
translations.kjv: If they obey and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
translations.ron: Dacă dau ascultare şi vin la supunere, ei îşi isprăvesc zilele lor în fericire şi anii lor în desfătări;
translations.grk: Ἐὰν ἀκούσωσι, καὶ δουλεύσωσι, συντελέσουσι τὰς ἡμέρας αὐτῶν ἐν ἀγαθοῖς, καὶ τὰ ἔτη αὐτῶν ἐν εὐπρεπείαις.

verses.geez: ወለኃጥአንሰ፡ ኢይሰምዖሙ፡ ወኢያድኅኖሙ፡ እስመ፡ ኢይፈቅዱ፡ ይርአይዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ወእንዘ፡ ይጌሥዖሙ፡ ኢይሰምዑ።
verses.translation: But he preserves not the ungodly; because they are not willing to know the Lord, and because when reproved they were disobedient.

translations.lxx: But he preserves not the ungodly; because they are not willing to know the Lord, and because when reproved they were disobedient.
translations.kjv: But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.
translations.ron: Iar dacă sunt neascultători, atunci trec prin strâmtorile morţii şi se sting nepricepuţi şi orbi.
translations.grk: Ἀσεβεῖς δὲ οὐ διασώζει, παρὰ τὸ μὴ βούλεσθαι αὐτοὺς εἰδέναι τὸν Κύριον, καὶ διότι νουθετούμενοι ἀνήκοοι ἦσαν.

verses.geez: ወደልዋን፡ ይኤድምዎ፡ ለልቦሙ፡ ለመዓት፡ ወየአወይዉ፡ አመ፡ አኅሠሮሙ።
verses.translation: And the hypocrites in heart will array wrath against themselves; they will not cry, because he has bound them.

translations.lxx: And the hypocrites in heart will array wrath against themselves; they will not cry, because he has bound them.
translations.kjv: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when he bindeth them.
translations.ron: Nelegiuiţii se mânie; ei nu se roagă lui Dumnezeu, când sunt puşi în lanţuri.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὑποκριταὶ καρδίᾳ τάξουσι θυμόν, οὐ βοήσονται, ὅτι ἔδησεν αὐτούς.

verses.geez: ወትትመሰው፡ ነፍሶሙ፡ በንእሶሙ፡ ወያሴርኅዋ፡ ለሕይወቶሙ፡ መላእክት።
verses.translation: Therefore let their soul die in youth, and their life be wounded by messengers of death.

translations.lxx: Therefore let their soul die in youth, and their life be wounded by messengers of death.
translations.kjv: They die in youth, and their life is among the unclean.
translations.ron: Unii ca aceştia se sting de tineri şi viaţa lor se veştejeşte în floare.
translations.grk: Ἀποθάνοι τοίνυν ἐν νεότητι ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτῶν, ἡ δὲ ζωὴ αὐτῶν τιτρωσκομένη ὑπὸ ἀγγέλων,

verses.geez: እስመ፡ አመንደቡ፡ ነዳየ፡ ወምስኪነ፡ ወሜጡ፡ ህትሐ፡ የዋሃን።
verses.translation: Because they afflicted the weak and helpless: and he will vindicate the judgment of the meek.

translations.lxx: Because they afflicted the weak and helpless: and he will vindicate the judgment of the meek.
translations.kjv: He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.
translations.ron: Dar pe cel nenorocit Dumnezeu îl scapă prin nenorocirea lui şi prin suferinţă Dumnezeu îi dă învăţătură.
translations.grk: ἀνθʼ ὧν ἔθλιψαν ἀσθενῆ καὶ ἀδύνατον, κρίμα δὲ πραέων ἐκθήσει.

verses.geez: ወተሣለቁ፡ ላዕሌከ፡ በአፈ፡ ጸላእትከ፡ ቀላይ፡ ይትከዓው፡ በታሕቴከ፡ ወትወርድ፡ ማእድከ፡ እንዘ፡ ምሉእ፡ ወጥሉል።
verses.translation: And he has also enticed thee out of the mouth of the enemy:

translations.lxx: And he has also enticed thee out of the mouth of the enemy:
translations.kjv: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness.
translations.ron: Tot aşa şi pe tine te va scoate din strânsoarea durerii, ca să te pună la loc larg, unde nu mai este nici o stinghereală şi unde masa ta va fi încărcată cu mâncări grase şi alese.
translations.grk: Καὶ προσεπιηπάτησέ σε ἐκ στόματος ἐχθροῦ, ἄβυσσος κατάχυσις ὑποκάτω αὐτῆς, καὶ κατέβη τράπεζά σου πλήρης πιότητος.

verses.geez: ወመዓቱ፡ ላዕለ፡ ተሣዓን፡ ትመጽእ፡ ዘነሥኡ፡ ሕልያነ፡ ከመ፡ የዓምዑ፡ ወኢይትረሣእከ፡ ዘቀዳሚ፡ ጌጋይከ።
verses.translation: there is a deep gulf and a rushing stream beneath it, and thy table came down full of fatness. Judgment shall not fail from the righteous;

translations.lxx: there is a deep gulf and a rushing stream beneath it, and thy table came down full of fatness. Judgment shall not fail from the righteous;
translations.kjv: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold on thee.
translations.ron: Dacă tu ai fost pedepsit cu străşnicie, ca un nelegiuit, tu scoate din pedeapsă puterea dreptăţii;
translations.grk: Οὐχ ὑστερήσει δὲ ἀπὸ δικαίων κρίμα,

verses.geez: ኢያስሕትከ፡ ሥላቅ፡ ወስላተ፡ ስኡናን፡ በምንዳቤሆሙ።
verses.translation: but there shall be wrath upon the ungodly, by reason of the ungodliness of the bribes which they received for iniquities.

translations.lxx: but there shall be wrath upon the ungodly, by reason of the ungodliness of the bribes which they received for iniquities.
translations.kjv: Because there is wrath, beware lest he take thee away with his stroke: then a great ransom cannot deliver thee.
translations.ron: Certarea Lui să nu te împingă la mânie împotriva Lui şi mulţimea bătăii să nu te scoată din calea cugetului drept.
translations.grk: θυμὸς δὲ ἐπʼ ἀσεβεῖς ἔσται, διʼ ἀσέβειαν δώρων ὧν ἐδέχοντο ἐπʼ ἀδικίαις.

verses.geez: ባሕቱ፡ ተዓቀብ፡ ወግበር፡ ሠናየ፡ ወኢትግበር፡ እኩየ፡ ወበእንተዝ፡ ትድኅን፡ እምንዴት።
verses.translation: Let not thy mind willingly turn thee aside from the petition of the feeble that are in distress.

translations.lxx: Let not thy mind willingly turn thee aside from the petition of the feeble that are in distress.
translations.kjv: Will he esteem thy riches? no, not gold, nor all the forces of strength.
translations.ron: Era oare să pună Dumnezeu vreun preţ pe bogăţiile tale? Nu! Nici pe aur, nici pe toate mijloacele puterii pământeşti.
translations.grk: Μή σε ἐκκλινάτω ἑκὼν ὁ νοῦς δεήσεως ἐν ἀνάγκῃ ὄντων ἀδυνάτων,

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ ጋያል፡ ያጸንዕ፡ በኃይሉ፡ ወመኑ፡ ዘይክል፡ ምስሌሁ፡ ተኃይሎ።
verses.translation: And draw not forth all the mighty men by night, so that the people should go up instead of them.

translations.lxx: And draw not forth all the mighty men by night, so that the people should go up instead of them.
translations.kjv: Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.
translations.ron: Nu pofti noaptea (depărtării de Dumnezeu), căci în ea, popoare întregi au fost smulse din locul lor.
translations.grk: καὶ πάντας τοὺς κραταιοῦντας ἰσχὺν μὴ ἐξελκύσῃς τὴν νύκτα, τοῦ ἀναβῆναι λαοὺς ἀντʼ αὐτῶν,

verses.geez: ወመኑ፡ ዘየሐትት፡ ምግባሮ፡ ወመኑ፡ ዘይብሎ፡ ምንተ፡ ገበርከ።
verses.translation: But take heed lest thou do that which is wrong: for of this thou hast made choice because of poverty.

translations.lxx: But take heed lest thou do that which is wrong: for of this thou hast made choice because of poverty.
translations.kjv: Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.
translations.ron: Ia seama, nu te duce la nedreptate, căci ea este adevărata cauză a suferinţei.
translations.grk: ἀλλὰ φύλαξαι μὴ πράξῃς ἄτοκα· ἐπὶ τοὺτων γὰρ ἐξείλω ἀπὸ πτωχείας.

verses.geez: ወተዘከር፡ ከመ፡ ዓቢይ፡ ግብሩ።
verses.translation: Behold, the Mighty One shall prevail by his strength: for who is powerful as he is?

translations.lxx: Behold, the Mighty One shall prevail by his strength: for who is powerful as he is?
translations.kjv: Behold, God exalteth by his power: who teacheth like him?
translations.ron: Da, Dumnezeu este nespus de mare prin puterea Lui! Cine poate să înveţe ca El?
translations.grk: Ἰδοὺ ὁ ἰσχυρὸς κραταιώσει ἐν ἰσχύι αὐτοῦ· τίς γάρ ἐστι κατʼ αὐτὸν δυνάστης;

verses.geez: እደው፡ እለ፡ ኰነኑ፡ ወእለ፡ ተኰነኑ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ ይሄሊ፡ ለሊሁ፡ ከመ፡ ምውታን፡ እሙንቱ፡ ኃጥአን።
verses.translation: And who is he that examines his works? or who can say, He has wrought injustice?

translations.lxx: And who is he that examines his works? or who can say, He has wrought injustice?
translations.kjv: Who hath enjoined him his way? or who can say, Thou hast wrought iniquity?
translations.ron: Cine I-a dat învăţătură cum să se poarte? Şi cine poate să-I spună: "Aceasta ai făcut-o rău?"
translations.grk: Τίς δέ ἐστιν ὁ ἐτάζων αὐτοῦ τὰ ἔργα; ἢ τίς ὁ εἰπὼν, ἔπραξεν ἄδικα;

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ ኃያል፡ ወዓቢይ፡ ወኢይትረአይ፡ ኍልቈ፡ ፍናዊሁ፡ ወኢይትአወቅ።
verses.translation: Remember that his works are great beyond those which men have attempted.

translations.lxx: Remember that his works are great beyond those which men have attempted.
translations.kjv: Remember that thou magnify his work, which men behold.
translations.ron: Adu-ţi aminte şi preamăreşte opera Lui, pe care o cântă, în laudele lor, oamenii;
translations.grk: Μνήσθητι, ὅτι μεγάλα ἐστὶν αὐτοῦ τὰ ἔργα, ὧν ἦρξαν ἄνδρες.

verses.geez: ወኢትኌለቊ፡ ነጠብጣበ፡ ዝንማ፡ ዘይትከዓው፡ እም፡ ውስተ፡ ደመና።
verses.translation: Every man has seen in himself, how many mortals are wounded.

translations.lxx: Every man has seen in himself, how many mortals are wounded.
translations.kjv: Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off.
translations.ron: Orice om o priveşte, măcar că o îmbrăţişează cu ochiul, numai de departe.
translations.grk: Πᾶς ἄνθρωπος εἶδεν ἐν ἑαυτῷ, ὅσοι τιτρωσκόμενοί εἰσι βροτοί.

verses.geez: ወያሠርዕ፡ ዘበልየ፡ ወይከድን፡ ደመና፡ ዲበ፡ መዋቲ፡ ወይትከዓው፡ ዝናም፡ ዘአልቦ፡ ኍልቊ።
verses.translation: Behold, the Mighty One is great, and we shall not know him: the number of his years is even infinite.

translations.lxx: Behold, the Mighty One is great, and we shall not know him: the number of his years is even infinite.
translations.kjv: Behold, God is great, and we know him not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.
translations.ron: Cât este de mare Dumnezeu! Dar noi nu putem să-L înţelegem şi numărul anilor Săi nu se poate socoti.
translations.grk: Ἰδοὺ ὁ ἰσχυρὸς πολύς, καὶ οὐ γνωσόμεθα· ἀριθμὸς ἐτῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπέραντος.

verses.geez: ወየአምር፡ ራኅበ፡ ደመናት፡ በአምጣነ፡ ጽላሎቱ።
verses.translation: And the drops of rain are numbered by him, and shall be poured out in rain to form a cloud.

translations.lxx: And the drops of rain are numbered by him, and shall be poured out in rain to form a cloud.
translations.kjv: For he maketh small the drops of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:
translations.ron: El atrage picăturile de apă, El le preface în aburi şi dă ploaia.
translations.grk: Ἀριθμηταὶ δὲ αὐτῷ σταγόνες ὑετοῦ, καὶ ἐπιχυθήσονται ὑετῷ εἰς νεφέλην.

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ ይሰፍሕ፡ አእምሮ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ወይደፍኖ፡ ለማዕበለ፡ ባሕር።
verses.translation: The ancient heavens shall flow, and the clouds overshadow innumerable mortals:

translations.lxx: Yet by all these things thy understanding is not astonished, neither is thy mind disturbed in thy body.
translations.kjv: Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly.
translations.ron: Iar norii o trec prin sita lor şi o varsă picături peste mulţimile omeneşti.
translations.grk: Ῥυήσονται παλαιώματα, ἐσκίασε δὲ νέφη ἐπὶ ἀμυθήτῳ βροτῷ· ὥραν ἔθετο κτήνεσιν, οἴδασι δὲ κοίτης τάξιν· ἐπὶ τούτοις πᾶσιν οὐκ ἐξίσταταί σου ἡ διάνοια, οὐδὲ διαλλάσσεταί σου ἡ καρδία ἀπὸ σώματος.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ቦሙ፡ ይኴንን፡ አሕዛበ፡ ወይሁቦ፡ ሲሳዮ፡ ለጽኑስ።
verses.translation: And though one should understand the outspreadings of the clouds, or the measure of his tabernacle;

translations.lxx: And though one should understand the outspreadings of the clouds, or the measure of his tabernacle;
translations.kjv: Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, or the noise of his tabernacle?
translations.ron: Cine poate să priceapă cum se desfăşoară norii şi cum bubuie tunetul în cortul lui?
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐὰν συνῇ ἐπεκτάσεις νεφέλης, ἰσότητα σκηνῆς αὐτοῦ,

verses.geez: ወለእንተ፡ ትንእስ፡ ይከድና፡ ብርሃነ፡ ወአዘዘ፡ ላቲ፡ ዘይዳደቃ።
verses.translation: behold he will stretch his bow against him, and he covers the bottom of the sea.

translations.lxx: behold he will stretch his bow against him, and he covers the bottom of the sea.
translations.kjv: Behold, he spreadeth his light upon it, and covereth the bottom of the sea.
translations.ron: Iată că El a rostogolit aburii Săi şi a acoperit adâncimile mării.
translations.grk: ἰδοὺ ἐκτενεῖ ἐπʼ αὐτὸν ἠδὼ, καὶ ῥιζώματα τῆς θαλάσσης ἐκάλυψεν.

verses.geez: ወይነግር፡ በእንቲአሁ፡ ዐርኩ፡ እንተ፡ ረከበቶ፡ በዓመጻሁ።
verses.translation: For by them he will judge the nations: he will give food to him that has strength.

translations.lxx: For by them he will judge the nations: he will give food to him that has strength.
translations.kjv: For by them judgeth he the people; he giveth meat in abundance.
translations.ron: Prin el Domnul hrăneşte popoarele şi le dă belşug de mâncare.
translations.grk: Ἐν γὰρ αὐτοῖς κρινεῖ λαούς, δώσει τροφὴν τῷ ἰσχύοντι.
